options.name: Skillet Chicken and Feta Rice
options.why: uses the most of what you have
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season chicken with salt and pepper, add to pan and cook until browned, about 6-7 minutes, until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Add onion and cook until soft, about 4 minutes.
Stir in cooked rice and spinach, cook until spinach wilts, about 2 minutes.
Remove from heat, sprinkle feta on top, and serve warm.

Toss chicken thighs and onion with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast for 25 minutes, then scatter spinach on top and roast another 5-8 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F internally.
Sprinkle feta over the top and let melt slightly before serving.

Crack eggs into the pan, scramble gently until fully set, about 3-4 minutes, until no runny egg remains.
Stir in feta, season with salt and pepper, and serve in a bowl.

options.name: Chicken and Spinach Egg Bake

Bake 15 minutes, then stir in spinach and return to the oven for 5 minutes until wilted.
Whisk eggs and pour over the chicken mixture, sprinkle feta on top.
Bake another 12-15 minutes until eggs are set and chicken reaches 165°F.
Let cool slightly before serving.

options.why: hands-off cooking while you get the rest of your day done

ingredients.text: 12 oz chicken breast, cut into strips

steps: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Toss chicken strips and broccoli with oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper on a sheet pan.
Spread in a single layer and roast 18-22 minutes, flipping halfway, until chicken reaches 165°F and broccoli is charred at the edges.
Meanwhile cook or reheat the rice.
Serve chicken and broccoli over the rice.

options.name: Cottage Cheese and Egg Breakfast Bowl
options.why: quick, no stove needed, and boosts your protein without much fuss
steps: Crack eggs into a microwave-safe bowl and beat lightly with a fork.
Microwave in 30 second bursts, stirring between each, until eggs are fully set and no longer runny, about 90 seconds to 2 minutes, reaching 160°F or firm throughout.
Season with salt and pepper.
Warm the rice in the microwave for 1 minute.
Spoon cottage cheese over the eggs and serve alongside the warm rice.

shown.name: Beef Tomato Cheese Bowl

options.name: Beef and Tomato Pasta
options.why: uses the most of what you have
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until tender, about 10 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a pot over medium heat and brown the ground beef, breaking it up, until no pink remains and it reaches 160°F.
Add the canned tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes, season with salt and pepper.
Stir in the drained pasta and toss to coat.
Top with cheese and serve while hot.

options.name: Cheesy Beef Baked Pasta
options.why: good use of the oven while you relax
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Boil pasta until just tender, drain.
Brown ground beef in a pan with oil until cooked through to 160°F, season with salt and pepper.
Mix pasta, beef, and chopped tomatoes in a baking dish.
Top with cheese and bake 12-15 minutes until melted and bubbly.
Let cool a few minutes before serving.

options.name: Beef Tomato Cheese Bowl
options.why: fastest of the three, no stove needed
steps: Place ground beef in a microwave-safe bowl, breaking it into small chunks.
Microwave on high 2 minutes, stir, then microwave another 2 minutes until fully cooked to 160°F with no pink.
Stir in diced tomatoes and season with salt and pepper.
Top with cheese and microwave 30 seconds to melt.
Stir and serve warm.

options.name: Spinach Feta Chickpea Rice Bowl
options.why: uses the most of what you have without any meat
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas and cook for 3-4 minutes until warmed through and slightly crisp.
Add spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Stir in the cooked rice and mix well, warming through.
Remove from heat, top with feta, and season with salt and pepper.

options.name: Baked Spinach Feta Egg Cups
options.why: no stove needed and a fast way to work in eggs and greens
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a muffin tin with the olive oil.
Whisk eggs in a bowl with salt and pepper.
Stir in chopped spinach and feta.
Pour mixture evenly into muffin cups.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until eggs are set and reach 160°F.
Let cool a few minutes before removing from tin.

options.name: Chickpea Chicken Rice Salad Bowl
options.why: closest to your protein for the day with no cooking needed for most of it
steps: Make sure chicken breast is fully cooked to 165°F before shredding, or use leftover cooked chicken.
In a large bowl, combine rice, chickpeas, and spinach.
Add shredded chicken and toss.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Top with feta, season with salt and pepper, and toss gently to combine.

options.name: Ginger Chicken and Bok Choy Rice Bowl
options.why: uses the most of what you have and gets your protein in
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned and internal temperature reaches 165°F, about 8 minutes.
Push chicken aside, add ginger and garlic, cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add bok choy and cook 2 to 3 minutes until wilted but still bright.
Season with salt and pepper, serve over cooked rice.

options.name: Crispy Tofu and Bok Choy Stir-Fry
options.why: a plant-based option that still uses your rice and bok choy

ingredients.text: 14 oz firm tofu, cubed and pressed

steps: Press tofu to remove excess water, then cube it.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat and add tofu.
Cook tofu, turning occasionally, until golden and crisp on most sides, about 8 minutes.
Add ginger and garlic, stir 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add bok choy and cook 2 to 3 minutes until just tender.
Season with pepper and serve over rice.

options.name: Chilled Ginger Chicken Rice Salad
options.why: no stove needed, good for a quick meal using leftover-style ingredients
steps: In a large bowl, combine cooled rice, shredded chicken and raw bok choy.
Whisk together sesame oil, hot sauce, ginger and a pinch of pepper.
Pour dressing over the bowl and toss well to coat everything evenly.
Chill for 10 minutes if time allows, then serve cold.

options.name: Turkey Zucchini Pasta Bake

steps: Boil pasta until just under done, drain.
Heat oil in a pan, brown ground turkey with garlic until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Stir in zucchini slices and cook 4 minutes until slightly soft.
Mix in marinara sauce, pasta, salt and pepper.
Pour into a baking dish, top with parmesan.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly and cheese is melted.

options.name: One-Pot Turkey Zucchini Marinara
options.why: fastest of the three, one pot for easy family cleanup
steps: Heat oil in a large pot, brown ground turkey until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Add zucchini and cook 3 minutes.
Stir in dry pasta, marinara, and broth.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook 15 minutes stirring occasionally until pasta is tender.
Season with salt and pepper, top with parmesan before serving.

options.name: Grilled Turkey Zucchini Skewers with Parmesan Pasta
options.why: gets the family outside and grilling while pasta cooks inside

ingredients.text: 1 lb ground turkey, formed into meatballs

steps: Form ground turkey into small meatballs and thread onto skewers alternating with zucchini slices.
Brush with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Grill over medium heat, turning occasionally, until turkey reaches internal temp of 165°F, about 12 minutes.
Meanwhile boil pasta until tender, drain and toss with marinara sauce.
Top pasta with parmesan and serve alongside the skewers.

options.name: Pan-Seared Chicken with Rice

steps: Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and chicken, cook 5-6 minutes per side until internal temp hits 165°F.
Slice chicken and serve over cooked rice.

options.name: One-Pot Chicken and Rice
options.why: fastest cleanup, cooks together in one pot
steps: In a pot, brown chicken pieces over medium heat until no longer pink, internal temp 165°F.
Add onion and garlic powder, cook 2 minutes.
Stir in rice and broth, bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 18-20 minutes until rice is tender.
Season and serve.

options.name: Chicken Rice Bowl with Herbs
options.why: no stove needed, quick assembly using leftovers
steps: Place rice in a bowl.
Top with shredded chicken.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle parsley.
Season with salt and pepper, toss and serve.
